transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we approach the final production approval on Friday afternoon, I need to run our routine round-robin preflight review of the Mara Chen retrospective catalog package. The current draft includes the print catalog, a downloadable digital edition, several archival photographs, and a sponsor acknowledgment. I'd like to go through each area systematically — archive, rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads — so we can flag any issues before I sign off. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue I found this morning. I located the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive in the archive file, and it imposes two hard constraints we haven't reflected in the production brief yet: first, the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog; second, the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. Both of these directly conflict with our current draft package as described, so we need to address this before Friday's approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. I confirmed by email yesterday that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos,' and that the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. I haven't entered this confirmation in the rights register yet, so it's not visible to the rest of you in our system.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two accessibility requirements from my test. First, the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF. Second, every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. My test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist, so these requirements aren't visible to the rest of you yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team, so they may not be aware of these constraints.
transcript.speaker: A5
